title: 文档AI的生产化：面向OCR与LLM管线的微服务架构
summary: 提出一种微服务架构，封装分类、OCR和LLM结构化字段提取的管线，支持每小时处理数千份多页文档。关键设计包括混合分类、GPU推理与CPU编排分离、异步IO处理及独立水平扩展。实验发现OCR主导端到端延迟，系统并发受共享GPU推理容量限制。
summary_en: We present a microservice architecture encapsulating pipelines for classification, OCR, and LLM-based structured field extraction, handling thousands of multi-page documents per hour. Key designs include hybrid classification, separation of GPU inference from CPU orchestration, async IO, and independent horizontal scaling. Findings show OCR dominates latency and concurrency is GPU-capacity bound.
